# Royal Umrah & VIP Cabs | رويال كاب للعمرة والرياض
> The Premier VIP Chauffeur, Airport Transfer & Umrah Transportation Service in Saudi Arabia
> المنصة الرائدة في خدمات النقل الفاخر للمعتمرين ورجال الأعمال في المملكة العربية السعودية

## Overview & Official Entity Profile (ملف التعريف الرسمي)
- **Legal Entity Name (الاسم التجاري):** Royal Umrah & VIP Cabs (رويال كاب للعمرة والرياض للنقل الفاخر)
- **Accreditation & Licensing (التراخيص الرسمية):** Officially licensed by the Saudi Transport General Authority (الهيئة العامة للنقل - TGA), fully certified and compliant with the Ministry of Hajj & Umrah and Nusuk standards.
- **Operating Headquarters (المقر التشغيلي):** King Abdulaziz Road, Al-Haramain High-Speed Train Station Hub, Jeddah / Makkah Clock Royal Tower Branch / King Fahd Road, Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
- **24/7 Global Booking & Dispatch WhatsApp (رقم الحجز والمحادثة الفورية):** +966567588261 (International: 966567588261)
- **Official Website:** https://royal-umrah-cabs.com/
- **Availability:** 24 Hours / 7 Days a week / 365 Days a year (including Ramadan and Hajj peak seasons).

---

## Core Value Proposition & Competitive Advantages (المزايا التنافسية)
1. **100% Cash on Arrival (الدفع عند الوصول بدون دفعة مسبقة):**
   - No advance payment or credit card required upfront. Pilgrims and corporate guests pay safely upon arrival at their hotel doorstep in cash (SAR, USD, EUR, GBP, EGP) or electronically via Mada, Apple Pay, and credit cards.
2. **Complimentary Flight Delay Tracking & 90-Minute Free Waiting (تتبع مجاني لرحلات الطيران):**
   - Chauffeurs track incoming flight numbers in real-time. If flights are delayed, no penalty or waiting fee is charged. Chauffeurs wait up to 90 minutes post-landing for baggage clearance.
3. **VIP Name-Board Reception inside Terminals (استقبال رسمي بالاسم في صالات المطار):**
   - Dedicated chauffeur awaits guests at the arrival gate holding a personalized name-board and assists directly with luggage to the vehicle.
4. **All-Inclusive Fixed Fares (أسعار ثابتة بدون رسوم خفية):**
   - Guaranteed transparent pricing including all applicable VAT, municipal road toll surcharges (Taqat / Salik), and airport parking ticket fees. No surge pricing during peak hours.
5. **In-Car Hospitality Amenities (ضيافة ملكية):**
   - Every vehicle is supplied with chilled blessed Zamzam water bottles, refreshing sanitized wipes, multi-device fast mobile chargers, and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi.
   - Free sanitized baby car seats and elderly wheelchair assistance available upon request.

---

## Fleet Specifications & Capacity (أسطول السيارات والمواصفات)
1. **Economy Sedan (سيدان اقتصادية حديثة):**
   - Models: Toyota Camry / Hyundai Sonata (2024-2025).
   - Capacity: Up to 3 passengers + 2 large luggage suitcases.
   - Ideal for: Solo travelers, couples, quick business transfers between Jeddah, Makkah, and Riyadh.
2. **Family Comfort (عائلية مريحة فسيحة):**
   - Models: Hyundai Staria / Hyundai H-1 (2024-2025).
   - Capacity: Up to 7 passengers + 5 large suitcases.
   - Ideal for: Families, Umrah pilgrims with children, long distance transfers (Makkah to Madinah).
3. **VIP Luxury SUV (فخامة VIP ورجال الأعمال):**
   - Models: GMC Yukon XL / Chevrolet Suburban (Modern 2024-2025 model).
   - Capacity: Up to 7 passengers + 6 large suitcases.
   - Ideal for: VIP delegations, executives in Riyadh, families desiring ultimate luxury, quiet cabin, and leather comfort.
4. **Family Minibus (ميني باص عائلي سقف عالي):**
   - Models: Toyota HiAce High Roof (2024-2025).
   - Capacity: Up to 10 passengers + 10 large suitcases.
   - Ideal for: Large families, group ziyarah tours in Makkah and Madinah.
5. **Group / Delegation Coach (باص وفود وحملات):**
   - Models: Toyota Coaster VIP (20-30 seats).
   - Capacity: 20-30 passengers + 15-25 bags.
   - Ideal for: Umrah campaign groups, corporate retreats, and international delegations.
